rationale: Final policy: PreparedCuda keeps ordinary execution as the default; execution_mode=cuda-graph remains explicit. Historical TensorIR replay gains qualify those workloads but do not establish automatic capture admission for arbitrary prepared consumers. In particular, a global ResourcePlan has no qualified graph retained-storage candidate and therefore uses ordinary fallback. Explicit graph invalidation, identity checks, failure fallback and existing method-owned HF graphs remain unchanged; this decision concerns TensorIR automatic promotion only.
revisit_condition: Reopen automatic capture only with a bounded graph-storage candidate in the complete resource owner, identity-safe invalidation, repeated complete-endpoint benefit including capture, and ordinary fallback on resource/capture/identity failure.
